This is an application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. filed by the aforesaid
Applicant apprehending his arrest in C.R. No.5 of 2023 registered with Kasturba
Police Station, Mumbai for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273 and 328
of the Ipc and Section 59 of the Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006.
2. Heard Mr. Udwadia, learned counsel for the Applicant and Ms Takalkar, learned APP for the Respondent -State.
I have perused the records and considered the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the respective parties.
Megha 33_aba_323_2023.doc 3.
The case of the prosecution is that on 02/01/2022 at about 11.45 p.m. one Auto Riksha No.MH 47 X 5898 was intercepted.
It was found that Gutkha was being transported by the said Auto Riksha.

The contraband was seized and the sample was Mohd Sajid Maqsood Ahmed Khan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 17 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169709975/

sentences.text: Driver of the said Auto Riksha was arrested.
It is stated that on the basis of the information given by the driver of the said Auto Riksha, the Applicant has been arrayed as an accused in the said crime.
4. It is stated that issue of applicability of Section 328 of the IPC in the such cases is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
Be that as it may, apart from the statement of the co-accused there is no prima facie material to show that the Applicant was in any way involved in transporting the contraband.
The Applicant was granted interim bail on 02/02/2023.
5. Learned APP states that the Applicant has reported to the Investigating Officer and has co-operated with the investigation.
In such circumstances, no case is made out for custodial interrogation.
6. The application stands disposed of.

(SMT. ANUJA PRABHUDESSAI, J.)
